correctness.rationale: For X the join of 2r nonempty discrete parts and D^r(X) defined by r-faces with disjoint union a face, a vertex support is an r-subset of the 2r color labels. Three vertices would use 3r>2r parts for r>=2 and cannot span a face. Two vertices form an edge exactly for complementary r-supports; all p_I=product_{i in I}a_i transversal vertices and p_Ic choices are adjacent, yielding one complete K_{p_I,p_Ic} per unordered complement pair. Hence c=binom(2r,r)/2 components, reduced H0 rank c-1 and H1 rank sum (p_I-1)(p_Ic-1)=c(1+prod_i a_i)-e_r(a), torsion-free. Zero-row/column-sum integral edge matrices establish canonically H1(component)=augmentation Z[U_I]^0 tensor augmentation Z[U_Ic]^0, with minus tensor swap for part permutations exchanging bipartition shores. For all a_i=2, the cross-polytope consequence follows. Independently calculated r=2 sizes (2,3,1,2) components K_(6,2), K_(2,6), K_(4,3), H1 rank 16 by both formulas; finite cases do not establish the all-r claim.
